description: The Supply of Air Freight Capacity to Asian Markets is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by BITRE. The financial crisis, which struck the Asian region in 1997, had consequences for both the countries involved and the world as a whole. This study examines one aspect of the impact of the crisis on Australia the adequacy of the air freight network to carry Australian exports to Asian markets. Coverage is Australia, 1999 to 2000; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-10-24. Files and pages listed: PDF (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies and network flow and freight or traffic assignment models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
